dedupe_keys.name: equinix sg data centre cooling failure and dbs and citibank outage singapore october 2023

description: This post-event and recovery case follows a cooling failure at an Equinix data centre in Singapore on 14 October 2023 that took down the digital banking of DBS and Citibank. During a planned upgrade of the cooling system, a third-party contractor wrongly sent a signal that closed the valves from the chilled-water buffer tanks, temperatures in the halls rose above the operating range, and systems were shut down; online banking was fully or partly unavailable for about two days, with about 810,000 failed log-in attempts and 2.5 million payment and ATM transactions not completed, and some regional online services were also affected. The Monetary Authority of Singapore ordered both banks to investigate why they had not recovered within the required four hours, reduced their permitted activities and, although it does not regulate data centres, said it expects banks to pass its requirements into contracts with providers; DBS later cut its chief executive's pay over this and earlier outages. Coverage: one colocation facility and two banks in Singapore, October 2023 onwards. Format and access: free press reports and regulator statements; the bank and Equinix investigation reports are not public. Caveats: technical detail comes from preliminary findings reported in the press. Simulation uses: cascading failure from data-centre cooling into financial services, recovery-time objectives and failover, and hazard exposure of cooling plants during maintenance. Related records: the Azure Australia East and London heatwave outages are other cooling failures, and the OVHcloud Strasbourg fire shows a total facility loss.
